verdict.rationale: Supabase's branching feature explicitly supports creating isolated environments to test schema changes without touching production, and Supabase also exposes an MCP server so AI agents can interact with and modify projects. However, there's no direct evidence these two capabilities are wired together for agent-driven schema testing, and community feedback flags migration/local-dev workflows as Supabase's 'biggest weakness' plus security concerns about agents operating with elevated (RLS-bypassing) access.
